units.source_text: “让你瞧见这副有失体面的模样……

en.t: I am sorry you have to see me looking so undignified...

units.source_text: 不过，他是我的老伴，你别担心。

en.t: But he is my old companion, so please do not worry.

units.source_text: 他相貌丑陋，已经动弹不了，请将就点吧。”

en.t: He is ugly and can no longer move, so please bear with him.”
